entities.summary: Sándor Bökönyi was a Hungarian archaeologist who specialized in zooarchaeology, the study of animal remains associated with human settlements. He was especially interested in the domestication and spread of horses in human history. Sándor Bökönyi was a naturalists & biologists from Vállaj (1926-03-17, Vállaj–1994-12-25). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to environmental history.
